Sport.object: Dance (Ballet, contemporary, modern, other styles like Irish, African, musical theater, hip-hop and jazz)

Analysis.object: Harmonious passion positively predicted self-esteem, whereas obsessive passion positively predicted self-evaluative perfectionism and DE.
Inequality of sample size of the dance styles represented. Self reported measures is the reliability of results. The current study utilized volunteers, potential responses bias may also be present.

Future research could usefully further investigate the perceived autonomy of dancers in relation to their passion, and the role that teachers play in the development of the two types of passion in the studio environment.
